parameters.query:
INSERT INTO indicator_values (indicator_id, run_id, period, geo, value, obtained_by, validation_status, consensus_score, raw_ref)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'ia_extraction', 'pre_valide_consensus', $6, $7)
ON CONFLICT (indicator_id, run_id, period, geo) DO NOTHING
RETURNING value_id;

UPDATE runs SET status = CASE WHEN $2::numeric = 1 THEN 'ok' ELSE 'partiel' END,
    closed_at = now(),
    note = 'Extraction composite A2 — consensus ' || round($2::numeric*100) || '%, ' ||
           CASE WHEN $2::numeric = 1 THEN 'pré-validé (indicator_values)' ELSE 'routé en file de validation humaine' END
WHERE run_id = $1;
UPDATE composite_queue SET statut = 'traite', run_id = $1, traite_le = now() WHERE doc_id = $2 RETURNING doc_id, period, statut;

nodes.name: Marquer le document traité
nodes.notes: La ligne de file passe à traite avec le run qui l'a consommée : le document ne sera pas retraité, et la file garde l'historique — quel run a traité quel document, et quand.
